description: Renovation contractor. On a single-storey bungalow re-side with a building area of 140 m2 we're adding 50 mm semi-rigid mineral wool boards over the existing OSB, strapping and fibre cement siding. We want to leave out the housewrap and let the mineral wool act as the drainage layer, with the board joints just butted together, not taped or lapped.
known_facts: 50 mm mineral wool exterior boards over OSB

missing_info.field: board rigidity, material specification and proposed drainage-plane and joint system
missing_info.why: The description says semi-rigid mineral wool; do not assume it meets the rigid insulating-sheathing permission or that its joint rule alone is the governing benchmark.
Section A of the variance form

should_cite.why: Candidate joint-detail conditions only if the insulating-sheathing permission applies to the specified board.
